# Amazon Linux 2023 RPM packages as of the 2023.12.20260930 release
<a name="all-packages-AL2023.12"></a>

The following list includes all packages for Amazon Linux 2023 release [2023.12.20260930](relnotes-2023.12.20260930.md).

## All AL2023.12 packages
<a name="AL2023.12"></a>

To understand what the support levels, milestones, and package origins in this list mean, see [Package support information](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/linux/al2023/release-notes/support-information.html).
